gods-heroes-rpg-classes.title: Gods & Heroes RPG Classes
gods-heroes-rpg-classes.body: # 🛡️ **Gods & Heroes: RPG Classes** ⚔️ _A mod created by an RPG player, for RPG players._ This mod brings to Minecraft the **classic RPG tabletop fantasy classes** inspired by systems like D&D — perfect for modpacks, custom adventures, or combining with race mods like **Origins** for deeper roleplay! 🧙‍♂️🎮 *** _ You need to install Iron's spells , simply swords , Apothic Attributes and Origins (Forge Or Fabric) to this mod function properly _ ### 🔥 **Included Classes:** * 🛡️ **Tank** * ✝️ **Paladin** _(Iron’s Spells compatible)_ * 💢 **Berserker** _(Simply Swords compatible)_ * 💚 **Healer** _(Iron’s Spells compatible)_ * 🔮 **Mage** – Frost, Fire, Ender, Evocation, Blood, Lightning _(Iron’s Spells compatible)_ * 🏹 **Hunter** _(Too Many Bows compatible)_ * 🗡️ **Rogue** _(Simply Swords compatible)_ * 🉐 **Samurai** _(Simply Swords compatible)_ * ⚔️ **Warrior** _(Simply Swords compatible)_ * ⚔️ **Spellblade** _(Simply Swords compatible)_ Each class comes with its own **unique starter equipment** and **special gameplay focus**! 🧰✨ *** ### 🧬 **Mod Compatibility:** ✅ Fully compatible with: * 🧙 **Iron’s Spellbooks** (Paladin, Mage, Healer) * 🗡️ **Simply Swords** (Samurai, Rogue, Warrior, Berserker) * 🏹 **Too Many Bows** (Hunter) * 🌟 **Origins & Origins Addons** (Combine with races and traits!) * 🐉 **Valarian Conquest** (Added on V1.2) * ✨ **Weapons of Miracles** (Added on V1.2) * ⚡ **Cataclysm** (Added on V1.2) * ⚔️ **Dungeons and Combat** (Added on V1.2) * 🛡️ **Magistu Armory** (Added on V1.2) * 👑 **Epic Knights** (Added on V1.2) * ❄️ **Ice and Fire** (Added on V1.2) * 💥 **Epic Fight** (Added on V1.2) * 🐠 **Aquaculture** (Added on V1.2) * 👻 **Souls Weapons** (Added on V1.2) * 🏯 **Samurai Dynasty** (Added on V1.2) * 🪄 **Wizard Samurai** (Added on V1.2) *** ### 🧠 **Class Selection System:** *** 🎯 Whether you're making a custom RPG server or just want deeper progression for your survival world, **Gods & Heroes: RPG Classes** is ready to bring a new layer of fantasy to your gameplay. ## 🧪 Want Races Too? Upgrade your RPG gameplay by pairing this addon with the **Gods & Heroes: RPG Races Mod**, featuring magical races like Elf, Orcs, Gnomes, and more. 👉 [**Click here to check out the Races Mod**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/gods-heroes-races) *** ## 🏰 Want the Full RPG Experience? Try the full **Gods & Heroes: Medieval Modpack**, featuring: * ✅ Custom stats and leveling * 🏹 Integrated races & classes * 🏯 Dungeon exploration * ✨ Magic mods like Iron’s Spells & Ars Nouveau * ⚔️ Combat mods like Simply Swords and Too Many Bows * 📜 Quest system (in development) * 👑 Bosses with tiered progression 👉 [**Explore the RPG Modpack here**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/gods-heroes-medieval) 🌐 **Play on our official server and be part of the story!** 🎮 Discord: [https://discord.gg/G5fG3RBS](https://discord.gg/G5fG3RBS) *** 🎮 Join the adventure. Shape your destiny. Become a Hero… or a God.~~~~

moraks-medieval-races.title: Gods & Heroes Races
moraks-medieval-races.body: # 🛡️ Gods & Heroes - Origins Addon ### 🌍 A Custom Origins Expansion for the *Gods & Heroes Medieval* Modpack Unleash your divine potential and embrace your heritage with **10 unique races**, each designed to bring a fresh experience to your world. This Origins addon focuses on **passive racial traits** that deeply shape your gameplay — while letting you choose your active **powers** separately. ⚔️ Compatible with magic, flight, and deep customization through integration with: - 🪄 **Iron’s Spells & Spellbooks** - 📚 **Ars Nouveau** - 🪽 **Icarus (Dynamic Wings & Flight Mod)** --- ## 🌟 Available Races ### 🧑 Human - Balanced and lucky: + Increased **Luck**, **Movement Speed**, **Attack Speed**, and **Block Breaking Speed** - A solid choice for any path. --- ### 🧝 Elf - Graceful and agile: + Bonus **Bow Damage** + **Climb walls**, pass through **leaves**, **Night Vision**, and **Reduced Fall Damage** --- ### ⛏️ Dwarf - Master of stone and tunnels: + **Faster mining**, **built-in Fortune**, and **can break blocks with bare hands** + **Night Vision** and **increased speed underground** + Slightly **shorter than 1 block** tall --- ### 💪 Orc - Brute strength and endurance: + **High Jump**, **Extra Health**, **Increased Damage**, and **Knockback Resistance** + **Taller** than the average player --- ### 🔥 Hellborn - Born of flame and shadow: + Cast **Fireballs**, **Immune to Fire**, **Healed by Lava** + **Affinity for Fire Magic**, **Night Vision**, and **Wings to fly** --- ### 😇 Aasimar - Descendants of celestial beings: + **Heal Allies**, **Natural Regeneration**, **Angel Wings** + Bonus **Holy Damage** and **Sacred Magic** + **Discounts with Villagers** --- ### 🐾 Feline - Swift and nimble hunters: + **Fast Movement**, **Jump Height scales with Speed**, **Extended item pickup range** + **No Fall Damage**, **Fast Melee Attacks** --- ### 🧙 Gnome - Tiny arcanists: + Extremely **Small Size** + **High Magic Affinity** — perfect for spellcasters --- ### 🐠 Fishman - Ocean-born warriors: + **Aquatic Origin** — breathe underwater, **Bonus Damage in Water**, **Aquatic Night Vision** + Can breathe **briefly on land** --- ### 🧚 Fairy - Mystical and elusive: + **Wings to Fly**, **Half-block tall**, **No Fall Damage** + Naturally gifted in **Magic Affinity** --- ## 🛠️ Designed for Modular Gameplay This addon is balanced around the idea of **passive races** with **complementary powers** handled by other mods in the modpack. Pick a race, pick a power — and become the legend you're meant to be. Whether you're a divine Aasimar, a stealthy Feline, or a flame-wielding Hellborn — the world of *Gods & Heroes Medieval* awaits. > ⚠️ Fully compatible with other Origins Addons, Magic Mods, and RPG systems. --- 🎮 Join the adventure. Shape your destiny. Become a Hero... or a God.

gods-and-heroes.title: Gods & Heroes (Origins)
gods-and-heroes.body: # **Motivation to Create this Mod** I was already tired of looking for modern superhero mods on the internet, and the ones I found were always the same, where you had to have the character's clothes, etc... I've always wondered what it would be like **if I had the powers on me** and not in a suit. Thinking about it, I created this mod, a mod of superheroes and gods. # Discord: https://discord.gg/EEmXHvkt3g # **Description of the Heroes and Gods:** In this mod, you can be: - **Ars Sorceress**: With the Mod Ars Nouveau installed you can chose this origin and become the absolute master of magics. **(FORGE ONLY)** - **The Spider-Man**: For those who always come to games to swing from web to web, and have fun climbing buildings. - **Nightcrawler**: For that person who likes to play like a rogue or just teleport around to kill some time, not big changes. - **Speedster (The Flash)**: For those who like to run across maps, explore faraway places, and return home quickly, enjoy a faster game. (you'll want to install food mods for this one) - **Vampire**: For that person who want to be the night, immortal, and a really new way to play the game, this is for you. - **Kryptonian (Superman)**: For those who want to feel like a superior being among all others, the one who, when we look up to the sky, is there, whether for good or for bad. - **Namur**: For that person who loves the ocean, and want to play like a fish... like a fish on lots of steroids. - **Blacksmith**: For that guy who always likes to play only within a village and make his entire base there, thinking about him and the best development during the game with several progress mechanics. - **The Builder**: For those who just like to play in the creative mode. This mod is just the start of the many ideas and projects I've already started to improve it. I count on your support to download and spread this superhero mod and motivate me more and more. # **Language** In the version 1.1.1 and above the language PTBR and EN are in the same jar, now you can chose to change in the minecraft settings # **Recommendations** Because of the amount of food Origins consumes, I recommend downloading these or other mods that add food to the game. For the faster speed, I recomend download StepUp Mod. Because of the trident loyalt enchant I recommend download the Better Trident Mod. - Meal API. - The Chocolate Mod Remastered. - StepUp Mod. - Better Trident Mod. # **Dependency:** - Origins Mod - Pehkui - Soulbound (Optional) - TooManyMods (Optional) # **Observations** - If you want to blacksmith have the power to lightup furnaces, you have to downlaod TooManyOrigins (only work on 1.19.2 and 1.20.x) ## Forge & Fabric - Version 1.6.0 and above is Forge and Fabric # Future New Heroes Updates: - Ant Man **(Marvel)** - Fell Free to suggest any origins on my discord. # Play with my modpack too: https://modrinth.com/modpack/kls - I'm creating this modpack to develop some kind of difficulty for the origins I'm creating, making the game more intense and probably too difficult to play as a normal human. # DONATES - Feel free to donate to my PayPal account; https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=PS5TJQ3QAWTTJ

apothic-attributes.title: Apothic Attributes
apothic-attributes.body: # Description Apothic Attributes is a library mod that provides a variety of attributes and attribute-related utilities, which makes interacting with, debugging, and using attributes much easier. The current list of Attributes is [available here](https://github.com/Shadows-of-Fire/Apothic-Attributes/blob/1.20/src/main/java/dev/shadowsoffire/attributeslib/api/ALObjects.java#L26). Most of the features are developer-facing, but there are a few user-facing components: # The Attributes GUI Apothic Attributes provides an Attributes GUI, accessible via the sword button in your inventory. This GUI shows all attributes that are attached to your player. You can filter the displayed attributes to only show modified attributes, and hovering an attribute will show a description and detailed information. # Armor Calculations To support the addition of Armor Pierce, Armor Shred, Protection Pierce, and Protection Shred, Apothic Attributes changes the way that damage reduction calculations are done, for both Armor and Protection. [In vanilla](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Armor#Mechanics), armor reduces damage based on your armor toughness value and the incoming damage value. With [Apothic Attributes](https://github.com/Shadows-of-Fire/Apothic-Attributes/blob/1.20/src/main/java/dev/shadowsoffire/attributeslib/api/ALCombatRules.java#L92), only armor reduces incoming damage, and armor toughness reduces the effectiveness of enemy Armor Shred and Armor Pierce. For specifics on damage formulas, [see here.](https://github.com/Shadows-of-Fire/Apothic-Attributes/blob/1.20/src/main/java/dev/shadowsoffire/attributeslib/api/ALCombatRules.java#L71) The changes in damage taken as a result of this can be seen in the following chart, where "New Apoth" is the formula currently used by Apothic Attributes. This chart does not take protection calculations into account. The changes to protection are described [here](https://github.com/Shadows-of-Fire/Apothic-Attributes/blob/1.20/src/main/java/dev/shadowsoffire/attributeslib/api/ALCombatRules.java#L48). # Potion Tooltips Another player-facing feature is the changes to potion tooltips. Descriptions will be added to potion items that are not simple attribute modifiers, and these descriptions (as well as the attribute modifiers) will be shown when hovering your active effects in the inventory. # Attribute Formatting Apothic Attributes allows attributes to format their own tooltips. The most notable example of attributes with custom formatting are Percent-Based Attributes, which always display their values in percentage form, regardless of their modifier type. The vanilla attributes **Speed** and **Knockback Resistance** are displayed in Percent-Based mode. Part of this feature is the additional tooltip information. When advanced tooltips (f3+h) are enabled, additional information about the modifier type and the underlying value will be shown. ## Advanced Tooltip Info Reference Addition modifiers will show text similar to **[+100]** Multiply Base modifiers will show text similar to **[+20x]** Multiply Total modifiers will show text similar to **[x10]** Note that Multiply Total values have their underlying value offset by +1, even in the advanced tooltip display. This is due to how they are applied (a multiply total modifier causes the final value to be multiplied by 1+value). # Developing Apothic Attributes depends on Placebo, and is available via maven: ```gradle maven { // Shadows_of_Fire's Maven url "https://maven.shadowsoffire.dev/releases" } dependencies { implementation fg.deobf("dev.shadowsoffire:Placebo:${mcVersion}-${placeboVersion}") implementation fg.deobf("dev.shadowsoffire:ApothicAttributes:${mcVersion}-${attributesLibVersion}") } ``` The API package (https://github.com/Shadows-of-Fire/Apothic-Attributes/tree/1.20/src/main/java/dev/shadowsoffire/attributeslib/api) of Apothic Attributes contains everything you should need to interface with from the mod. # Support Me [ ](https://discord.com/servers/shadows-mods-613010559532531713) [ ](https://www.akliz.net/shadows) ## Contact Discord:

too-many-bows.title: Too Many Bows
too-many-bows.body: ## Ready to become the **ultimate archer** in Minecraft? The **Too Many Bows** mod is here to completely revolutionize your ranged combat experience with **exciting new bows**, each packed with unique abilities that will take your gameplay to a whole new level. * Current bow counter: **38** bows done! * For the most up to date information about this mod please refer to the [wiki](https://wiki.pixeldreamstudios.net/mods/too-many-bows) *** ### 🔄 **Seamless Compatibility with Better Combat** ** ** To truly unlock the potential of this mod, we **strongly recommend using it with the [Better Combat](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/better-combat-by-daedelus) mod**. Experience fluid, dynamic combat that makes every shot feel impactful and satisfying. The combination of **Too Many Bows** and **Better Combat** creates a thrilling archery experience unlike anything you've seen before. *** ### 🔧 **Dependencies ** This mod requires the [**Architectury API**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/architectury-api) to function. Make sure to download it to enjoy the full experience! *** ### Version 3.0 for 1.21.1 (only) Adds: ### Attributes: * **Bow Draw Speed** Controls how quickly bows can be drawn. Higher values reduce draw time. * **Bow Damage** Increases base damage dealt by bow projectiles. * **Ranged Weapon Damage** Affects damage scaling for ranged weapons and special bow projectiles. ### Trinkets/Curio items * Dead Eyes Pendant - Increase Crit change ( stackable ) * Windwoven Gloves - Increase draw speed ( stackable ) * Fletchers Talisman - Reduce durability taken on bows * Sharpshot Ring - Bow damage boost ( stackable) * Stormbound Signet - Bow damage boost ( stackable ) ### All new trinkets are found in loot system * With this new attribute system other devs can create addon mods for **Too Many Bows** for more trinkets/Curio items! *** ### 🌟 **Ongoing Development** This is just the beginning! We're constantly working to add even **more powerful bows**, **custom arrows**, and unique abilities to keep the game fresh and exciting. Stay tuned for updates that will introduce new bows, crafting materials, and special enchantments. ### 📋 **Download Now and Transform Your Archery Skills!** Step into a world where your bow is your greatest ally. Download **Too Many Bows** today and experience the thrill of wielding powerful, unique bows that change the way you approach combat in Minecraft! **Note**: More bows and updates are on the way – keep an eye out for future releases! **[ ](https://www.bisecthosting.com/p/pixeldream)**
